text: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか　よく　かんがえた　ほうが　いい　ところで…　わざマシン３９には　がんせきふうじ　が　はいっている！

structure.jp: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか
structure.en: which Pokémon to teach it to

structure.jp: よく　かんがえた　ほうが　いい
がんせきふうじ　が　はいっている！

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: かんがえた　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb followed by ほうがいい gives advice: 'you'd better do it'. かんがえた　ほうが　いい = 'you should think about it'.

patterns.name: 〜か (embedded question)
patterns.span: どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか
patterns.explanation: か at the end of a question tucked inside a bigger sentence turns it into 'which…' or 'whether…'. どの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせるか = 'which Pokémon to teach it to'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone else do it; the one who is made to do it takes に. おぼえさせる = 'make it learn', so 'teach it'.
